comment: Events the behaviour check (cane_world_sweep behaviour) requires in a level's trace; a missing one fails the level.
Keys are object, state and segment ids (no game data): kind is one of sm, sma+, sma-, aseg+, aseg-, lo+, lo-, opt, ficg, state, transition;
key uses the trace's format (sm: 'sm@root:from>to', aseg+: 'aseg@root', lo+: 'oid:cid') and may hold '*';
by_frame (60 per second, counted from the first frame after the load) bounds when it must have happened, -1 for any time in the run.

events.why: the van door's volume button (VOLBTN 1860) comes back when the intro ends; it did not while the van's options were wiped
an opening animation plays on the van door (the state machine picks one of its segments, 1872 or 1874, at random)
the van door opens (state machine 1863 from closed 1871 to open 911)
